states.note: These are three different states. A field can exist without supported event semantics. Supported event semantics would still not make the full Cancelled or Terminated metric COMPARABLE.

event_date_candidate.reason: Column name and date/time SQL datatype both match. Semantic equivalence to Sisense enrollment.last_update_timestamp is unproven.

event_date_evidence.reason: The column exists and has a date/time SQL datatype. That is not proof it is a cancellation/termination event timestamp rather than a generic record-update timestamp. SUPPORTED is not assigned automatically.

lookback_bin.note: Descriptive reporting bin for dates before the filename-inferred snapshot date. Not a business definition of far-before.

cancelled_policies.reason: Independent semantic checks are not all PASS. FIELD EXISTS and even FIELD SEMANTICS SUPPORTED would not make this COMPARABLE.
